ActiveConfigRules.description_en: Enables multiple rules at once, changing their status to "Active"
ActiveConfigRules.description_zh: 批量启用指定的规则，使得规则状态处于“应用中”

DeleteConfigRules.description_en: Deletes multiple rules at a time

DescribeCompliance.description_en: Queries the statistics of compliance evaluation results
DescribeCompliance.description_zh: 查询资源的合规结果统计

DescribeComplianceSummary.description_en: Queries the summary of compliance evaluations of the current Alibaba Cloud account
DescribeComplianceSummary.description_zh: 查询当前账号的合规结果统计概要

DescribeConfigRule.description_en: Queries the details of a rule

DescribeConfigurationRecorder.description_en: Queries the configured scope for resource monitoring
DescribeConfigurationRecorder.description_zh: 查询设置的资源监控范围

DescribeDeliveryChannels.description_en: Queries information about configured delivery channels
DescribeDeliveryChannels.description_zh: 查询设置的投递渠道信息

DescribeDiscoveredResource.description_en: Queries the configuration details of a specified resource
DescribeDiscoveredResource.description_zh: 查询指定资源的配置详情

DescribeEvaluationResults.description_en: Queries the evaluation results of a rule
DescribeEvaluationResults.description_zh: 查询规则的评估结果列表

GetAggregateDiscoveredResource.description_en: Queries the details of a resource in an account group
GetAggregateDiscoveredResource.description_zh: 查询指定账号组内指定资源详情

GetDiscoveredResourceCounts.description_en: Queries the counts of discovered resources in the current account
GetDiscoveredResourceCounts.description_zh: 查询当前账号的资源数量

GetDiscoveredResourceSummary.description_en: Queries a summary of monitored resources
GetDiscoveredResourceSummary.description_zh: 查询监控中的资源概览

GetResourceComplianceTimeline.description_en: Queries the compliance evaluation timeline for a specified resource
GetResourceComplianceTimeline.description_zh: 查询指定资源的合规检测历史

GetResourceConfigurationTimeline.description_en: Queries the configuration history of a specified resource
GetResourceConfigurationTimeline.description_zh: 查询指定资源的配置变更历史

GetSupportedResourceTypes.description_en: Queries all resource types supported by CloudConfig
GetSupportedResourceTypes.description_zh: 查询配置审计支持的所有资源类型列表

ListAggregateDiscoveredResources.description_en: Lists the resources in a specified account group
ListAggregateDiscoveredResources.description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的资源列表

ListConfigRules.description_en: Queries the rules for the current account
ListConfigRules.description_zh: 查询当前账号规则列表

ListDiscoveredResources.description_en: Queries the list of resources for the current account
ListDiscoveredResources.description_zh: 查询当前账号资源列表

PutConfigRule.description_en: Creates or modifies a rule for the current account
PutConfigRule.description_zh: 为当前账号新建或修改规则

PutConfigurationRecorder.description_en: Adds or modifies the resource types that are monitored
PutConfigurationRecorder.description_zh: 新增或修改监控中的资源类型

PutDeliveryChannel.description_en: Creates or updates a delivery channel for your account
PutDeliveryChannel.description_zh: 为当前账号创建或更新投递渠道

StartConfigRuleEvaluation.description_en: Re-evaluates the compliance of resources based on a rule or compliance package
StartConfigRuleEvaluation.description_zh: 使该规则执行一次评估

StartConfigurationRecorder.description_en: Sets the resource monitoring scope for the current account
StartConfigurationRecorder.description_zh: 设置当前账号的资源监控范围

StopConfigRules.description_en: Disables multiple rules at a time so that the rules enter the INACTIVE state
StopConfigRules.description_zh: 批量停用指定规则，使规则处于“已停用”状态
